title: Grandparents Are Quietly Running A Second Foster System
hook: It's nearly 8 times bigger than official foster care.
closing: Somebody's grandma is quietly doing the government's job for free.
question: Did a grandparent ever raise you?

segments.say: 2.6 million kids are now being raised by grandparents or other relatives instead of foster care.
Drug overdose deaths soared to a peak of nearly 108,000 a year in 2022.
18.3 percent of grandparents raising grandchildren live in poverty, well above the national child poverty rate.
